text:
maya: Quick sync — framing the release slate for SDK + docs + sample apps. High level: changelog cutoff Thu EOD, canary Fri AM, production rollout later Fri if all green. Owners: SDK -> @alex, Docs -> @jen, Samples -> @sam. Call out blockers now.

alex: SDK status: core PRs mostly ready. Outstanding reviews on PR#3456, PR#3478, PR#3480. CI failing on python39 wheel build only (flaky binary). Will try a rebuild and ping reviewers.

sam: Sample apps: one flaky e2e on login flow. Short log: 
```
AssertionError: expected 200 got 500
  at tests/login.test.js:42:15
  Error: missing env SECRET_KEY
```
I can patch test to inject fixture creds but need confirmation on token endpoint shape. @alex does the auth mock match prod header `X-Auth-Token`?

alex: yes, mock uses `Authorization: Bearer <token>` right now — can add header alias. I will add `scripts/setup_dummy_auth.sh` and update sample config. ETA ~1h.

jen: Docs freeze starts Thu 5pm PT. Any public API/interface changes must have a docs note and deprecation callout. Translation/localization needs final strings by Wed noon — if copy changes after that we may miss translations. :eyes:

aaron: I'm owning changelog assembly. Please drop PRs with label `release-notes` by Thu 4pm. I'll collect and compile into the single changelog. If you need a hotfix after cutoff we'll follow the patch-branch flow.

maya: Two asks: 1) @alex — canary runner (small traffic, smoke tests) ready by Fri 09:00? 2) @sam — sample smoke gate in CI by Fri 06:00? If yes -> we can proceed on schedule.

alex: Canary runner script added in commit `ab3c9d` on my branch. Example run: `./scripts/canary_run.sh --subset=smoke`. I'll coordinate with @release-bot to schedule nightly. :+1:

release-bot: deploy-scheduler: scheduled canary run for 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z (id: run-8891).

sam: I can flip the sample smoke gate to 05:00, but I need one LGTM from QA (@sylvie) on the env stub changes.

sylvie: QA here — I'll run the smoke matrix once @alex pushes the auth stub. If flakes persist I'll post a short bug with repro steps.

jen: lgtm on the docs freeze side. Left a minor nit on the quickstart page that I can patch post-cutoff (non-blocking).

alex: pinged reviewers on PR#3478 and PR#3456, bumped CI rebuild for wheel.

maya: Final checklist before we call this green: 1) SDK PRs merged to main 2) Changelog PRs in `release-notes` by Thu 4pm 3) Canary runner scheduled and green on Fri AM 4) Docs freeze ack from localization. If any fail, we abort and reschedule.

aaron: Copy — I'll post assembled changelog by Thu 17:30 PT in this thread and tag release notes.

maya: Thanks all, appreciate quick turn. If anyone hits an emergency, call abort and we'll regroup. :thumbsup:
